name: pre-mortem
tagline_zh: 上线前别光开香槟，先给计划做个体检。把风险分成真老虎、纸老虎和大象，揪出没人敢说的隐患，再决定是拦路、跟进还是跟踪。
tagline_en: Before launch, don't just pop champagne—autopsy your plan. Sort risks into Tigers, Paper Tigers, Elephants, then.
desc_en: Run a pre-mortem risk analysis on a PRD or launch plan. Categorizes risks as Tigers (real problems), Paper Tigers (overblown concerns), and Elephants (unspoken worries), then classifies as launch-blocking, fast-follow, or track. Use when preparing for launch, stress-testing a product plan, or identifying what could go wrong.
why_zh: 同类工具只会列风险清单，它却用动物隐喻逼你直面权力暗流，把不敢说的担忧摆上台面。
why_en: Unlike generic risk checklists, it uses animal metaphors to surface power dynamics and unspoken worries, making them impossible.
